LESSON: HEAT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Healthy Environment
Topic 2.3: Heat
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Heat, part of Healthy Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: how to keep safe when dealing with Why is heat important in daily life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
